name: B10-0225/2025 (S&D) – Execution spree in Iran and the confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the execution spree in Iran and confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Iran. It condemns the death sentences against activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani and others, and the sharp rise in executions, especially of women. It asks Iran to stop the executions and free detained European nationals. It also asks European Union countries to consider targeted sanctions on Iranian officials and to treat Iran's Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist organisation.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It targets Iranian officials and the Revolutionary Guard, and affects detained European nationals.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union bodies and Iranian authorities; they decide whether to act.
